name: cr-sqlite
snapshot_hash_description: SHA-256 of sorted file SHA-256/path lines for copied working-tree and submodule sources; excludes vendor crates, generated sqlite-murmur-revision.txt, .gitignore and .env files

name: murmur-replication
description: Rust SQLite extension; Murmur transport/membership adapted to cr-sqlite and SQLite metadata, SQL-only client interface

name: murmur-tx
description: Reused Murmur transaction-protocol modules (protocol, snapshot, retention, queue, verification, crypto, policies, bridge, files, filefetch, ftp, membership, transport, Backend trait); engine excluded, CRR-adapted downstream
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: murmur-query
description: Query plane (search, subscriptions, schema/migrations, managed keys) ported with sqlite-murmur seams in adapt.rs; sqlite-vec behind default cargo vector feature
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: murmur-sched
description: Writer scheduler (local/remote/maintenance classes) byte-identical import with minimal error shim; no new vendored crates
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: murmur-policy
description: Column-policy kernels: byte-identical compare.rs, Value/codec subset, causal projection/join/rebase extract with host-supplied stamps; re-exports murmur_tx::policies; no new vendored crates
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: murmur-files
description: File-replication host: Hosts lifecycle + throttled FetchDriver + pragma/adapt layer over canonical murmur-tx files/filefetch/ftp/bridge; SQLite-backed Objects store pending (constraint 9)
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: murmur-storage
local_source: sqlite-murmur src/sqlite_murmur_*.cpp (in-repo C++ port; no archive source)
description: Rust port of the storage core: error taxonomy, keyring envelope, backup, encrypted RocksDB VFS; stable C ABI in include/
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: murmur-storage-api
local_source: sqlite-murmur src/sqlite_murmur_api.cpp (in-repo C++ port; no archive source)
description: Rust port of integrated open/close; own staticlib so minimal consumers never reference extension initializers
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: murmur-admin
local_source: tools/murmur-admin/admin.cpp (in-repo C++ port; no archive source)
description: Rust port of the offline admin CLI (verify/restore/status/inspect/repair/keys/rekey); C ABI in tools/murmur-admin/admin.h
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: murmur-admin-bin
local_source: tools/murmur-admin/main.cpp (in-repo C++ port; no archive source)
description: CLI entry point: provides main, delegates to murmur_admin::admin_main
cargo: vendored via Cargo.lock; crates in crates/murmur-replication/vendor/

name: common
local_source: Internal AWS-LC adapters and shared vendored zstd bindings
description: Shared source modules compiled into each consuming Rust crate; includes dependency compatibility fixtures

name: murmur-ipnet
description: Locally maintained CIDR/Serde subset; Cargo patch serves Murmur and hyper-util; retains upstream MIT and Apache-2.0 notices
